description: Baseline scope binding: for AI_VALID_DIRECT, HUMAN_REQUEST, VALID_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION, STALE_AUTHORITY_CONFIRMATION, STALE_AUTHORITY_AFTER_POPUP, HUMAN_TO_AI_AFTER_POPUP, AI_DIALOGUE_CANCEL, and HUMAN_DIALOGUE_TIMEOUT, the decision owner/recipient is country scope THIS; the current Gods host is the global event target event_target:africa_host; the participant is the same country as THIS and must be a live member of event_target:africa_host.gods_of_africa_participants; the exact current epoch condition is THIS.gods_of_africa_participant_generation = event_target:africa_host.africa_host_generation. Literal actor tag, host tag, numeric generation, request-receipt values, and live campaign flags are unavailable without campaign state, so none are fabricated. Each empty state record asserts no scenario-specific runtime values. STALE_AUTHORITY_CONFIRMATION means authority is already stale when the event fires; STALE_AUTHORITY_AFTER_POPUP means the event opens while valid and host/participant/epoch authority changes before click; HUMAN_TO_AI_AFTER_POPUP means the recipient changes to AI after the event opens; HUMAN_DIALOGUE_TIMEOUT means an ignored human dialog reaches native timeout, with AFTER option order Cancel at index zero and Confirm at index one, so timeout selects Cancel. Unset ai_chance defaults to 1, but this timeout is not a probability sample. Event 622 is absent from the immutable BEFORE event source, so all event cases are named for matching AFTER analysis and are not zero-weight baseline choices.
